release: TRYAMM Birthday Alpha - Google Play Candidate

playConsoleBirthdayAlpha.reason: Google Play has no exact age-12-only target bucket. Selecting Ages 9-12 means the app targets children throughout that group, which is not an accurate fit for the current LIVE/PK, direct-interaction, combat and mature-lane feature set.
playConsoleBirthdayAlpha.futureFamilyTrack: Create a separate 9-12 Family experience with child-appropriate content, no unrestricted direct interaction, child-safe SDK/data practices, adult-managed social controls, and Families-compliant monetization/ads before selecting Ages 9-12.

ratingAuthority: IARC via Google Play Console questionnaire
ratingRule: Do not hardcode or promise a regional 12+ rating. Final regional ratings are assigned from the submitted IARC questionnaire and actual app content.

audienceSafety.under13: not a target audience for the birthday Google Play alpha; social LIVE/PK remains gated
audienceSafety.teen: age-appropriate social features plus report/block/mute and online-safety controls
audienceSafety.adult: full LIVE/PK capability subject to moderation, provider readiness and mature-lane restrictions

androidSigning.behavior: PRs build an unsigned candidate. A manually dispatched release workflow must have all upload-key secrets and produces a jarsigner-verified signed AAB.

googlePlayRequirements: accurate Target audience and content declaration
UGC terms, report, block, mute and moderation controls
camera and microphone disclosure and runtime permission handling
in-app and web account deletion request path
signed Android App Bundle using the Play upload key
Play Console internal or closed testing before production
releaseTruth: Build-ready is not Play-approved. Store rating and approval remain pending until the Play Console declarations, signed AAB upload, testing track and Google review are complete.
